visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized graphic background consisting of pastel yellow, green, and blue gradients. Large, three-dimensional blue and pink text is centered on the screen, while a small white logo is visible in the upper left corner. (2) A young man with bleached blonde hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and a black necktie, is seated at a white desk in a brightly lit indoor studio. He looks directly at the camera with an earnest expression, gesturing frequently with his hands to emphasize his points. To his left, a small vase with purple flowers sits on the desk, and a silver laptop is partially visible. The background is a clean, minimalist white wall. (3) The camera cuts to another young man with vibrant pink hair wearing a grey blazer over a white shirt. He is seated in a different office environment with a darker grey wall background. Behind him, a shelf holds several golden trophies or awards and a circular logo featuring the letters 'T.G.D.P'. He has a perplexed facial expression, squinting slightly as he looks toward the camera. (4) The scene returns to the first man, who is now much more physically expressive, using wide arm movements and pointing his fingers. Large yellow variety text with blue outlines occasionally covers the lower half of his body. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the studio scenes.

It uses exaggerated acting and fast-paced editing to create humor while addressing serious labor regulation topics like minimum wage and overtime pay.
